[http://cache-www.belkin.com/support/dl/UserManual.pdf Manual] "AJT00C-1.0" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. :This is the same text found on the [[Linksys WUSB6300]]'s board. This thing is using two [http://www.rfmw.com/datasheets/skyworks/SE5022T_DS.pdf '''Skyworks''' ('''SiGe''') 5022T / SE5022T 5GHz Power Amplifiers] and two [http://www.skyworksinc.com/uploads/documents/SKY85601_11_202865A.pdf '''Skyworks''' SKY85601 (SKY85601-11?) SDPT Switch w/ LNA modules]. The USB ID for this device is 050d:1109. :It is specified in the driver set for the [[Edimax EW-7822UAC]] as being for an AC950 '''Belkin''' device. '''Realtek 11ac 8812A USB WLAN MP Diagnostic Program 0.0027.20121102''' was the test program specified as used in the FCC docs. {{WiFiCert|WFA17796|12/28/2012}} According to [http://forums.linuxmint.com/viewtopic.php?f=53&t=191361 this topic on the Linux Mint forum], the driver from [https://github.com/abperiasamy/rtl8812AU_8821AU_linux GitHub] works with this device.
